saeroth-pf2e-content.setup: 180 x 120ft, 36 x 24 five-foot squares. Three native v14 levels: ground 0ft, cellar -10ft, bedrooms 10ft. 8 ground-floor doors, 5 cellar doors and 8 bedroom doors. West wine-room door starts locked. Solid walls block sight/light/sound; low furniture blocks movement only. Guest stairs rise north from the taproom; upstairs exit north and follow the east-side landing into the corridor. Switch token level/elevation manually at stairs (see README for landing coordinates). No teleport automation, roof tiles, actors or audio. Furniture and open door leaves are painted background art; door controls determine actual passage. Import with installed local map assets.
